name: Cadet Training
intro: Join Kestrel's Lance for six short lessons, starting with movement and weapon attacks and ending with full-lance tactics. Each battle is real BattleTech combat, with optional practice checks that reward using what you learn. Losses still unlock the next lesson, and you can retry any mission to improve your record. After the basic course, the Advanced Tactical Academy puts specialist equipment and mission objectives into practice.

missions.title: 1. First Steps
missions.briefing: Your first time at the controls of the company's Wolverine. A training Commando waits at the far end of the valley. Learn to move, aim and shoot.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "Not bad for a first run. You moved, you shot, you lived. Next time the target won't stand in the open."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "Everybody loses their first one. Watch where the hits landed on the Sheet and try again, or move on and learn from the next lesson."

practice.title: Move your Wolverine at least one hex

missions.title: 2. Shadows in the Trees
missions.teaches: To-hit modifiers: range, movement, woods, line of sight
missions.briefing: A fast Jenner raider is hiding in the forest. Before you can catch it you need to understand why some shots are easy and others nearly impossible.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "You read the numbers before you pulled the trigger. That's the whole game, cadet."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "Fast 'Mechs in woods are a nightmare. Get close, stay out of its rear arc and make it come to you."

practice.title: Find a shot needing 8 or less

missions.title: 3. Running Hot
missions.teaches: Heat scale, heat sinks, shutdown, high ground
missions.briefing: Your Wolverine is in for repairs, so you borrow the company's Warhammer. Its two PPCs hit hard and run hot. Keep it under control against a Griffin and a Wasp.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "You fired when it counted and cooled off when it didn't. That's how you keep a Warhammer alive."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "A hot 'Mech is slow, inaccurate and one bad roll from blowing its own ammo. Next time, count the heat before you fire."

practice.title: Fire a weapon from the Warhammer
Finish a later turn at 7 heat or less

missions.title: 4. Watch Your Back
missions.teaches: Lances, firing arcs, torso twists, rear armor, critical hits
missions.briefing: Your Wolverine is back and you get a wingman: Corporal Daan in a Hunchback. Two fast enemies will try to get behind you.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "Two 'Mechs working together beat two working alone. And you kept your backs covered."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "Rear armor is paper. Keep the light 'Mechs in your front arc and finish them while they're close."

missions.title: 5. Knife Fight
missions.teaches: Punches, kicks, hatchets, charges, falling, buildings
missions.briefing: Urban training. You take the Hatchetman, Daan brings your old Wolverine. The enemy starts close, so expect fists, feet and a hatchet.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "You kept your footing and made every swing count. Close quarters belongs to you now."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "A missed kick lands you on your back. Pick the attack whose to-hit and risk you can live with."

missions.title: 6. Final Exam
missions.teaches: Everything together: a full lance, water, jumping
missions.briefing: Your full lance against a full enemy lance at the river crossing. No new tricks: use everything you've learned. Consider setting explanations to Light.
missions.debrief_win: Sergeant Vey: "Welcome to Kestrel's Lance, MechWarrior. Build your own forces from the start screen any time."
missions.debrief_loss: Sergeant Vey: "Close one. You know the rules now; the rest is practice. Replay any lesson or build your own battle from the start screen."

missions.title: 1. Fire Over the Ridge
missions.briefing: Bring the Archer's LRMs to bear with a mobile spotter. Keep the Archer behind the ridge where possible; send the Wolverine to a position that sees the target.
missions.debrief_win: Instructor Vey: Good work. Review the tactical record before the next exercise.
missions.debrief_loss: Instructor Vey: Review the objective and positioning, then retry or continue.

practice.title: Fire a shot with the indirect-fire modifier

missions.title: 2. Signals and Shadows
missions.teaches: ECM, active probes and stealth armor
missions.briefing: Use your Men Shen's active probe against an opponent equipped with stealth and ECM. Scout with the Men Shen; keep the supporting Hunchback close enough to exploit a target.
missions.debrief_win: Instructor Vey: Good work. Review the tactical record before the next exercise.
missions.debrief_loss: Instructor Vey: Review the objective and positioning, then retry or continue.

practice.title: Find a firing solution of 8 or better

missions.title: 3. Combined Arms
missions.briefing: Command a Timber Wolf, a tank and Elemental battle armor against a mixed force. Vehicles and battle armor have their own movement and damage rules. Check their record sheets; use the Elementals to screen approaches.
missions.debrief_win: Instructor Vey: Good work. Review the tactical record before the next exercise.
missions.debrief_loss: Instructor Vey: Review the objective and positioning, then retry or continue.

practice.title: Declare attacks from two friendly units
Board eligible infantry onto a transport

missions.title: 4. Hold the Junction
missions.briefing: Capture the central junctions instead of chasing kills. Send units toward the marked objective hexes. Check each objective's control radius.
missions.debrief_win: Instructor Vey: Good work. Review the tactical record before the next exercise.
missions.debrief_loss: Instructor Vey: Review the objective and positioning, then retry or continue.

missions.title: 5. Break Contact
missions.briefing: Move a screening force through the enemy line and exit rather than fight to destruction. Your designated exit is the northern edge. Move toward it and preserve movement capacity.
missions.debrief_win: Instructor Vey: Good work. Review the tactical record before the next exercise.
missions.debrief_loss: Instructor Vey: Review the objective and positioning, then retry or continue.

practice.title: Exit one unit through the mission edge
